queen_seen.not_seen: The beekeeper looked for the queen and did not see her.
queen_seen.not_looked_for: The beekeeper says they did not look for the queen.

brood.all_stages: Eggs, larvae and capped brood are all present.
brood.no_eggs: Larvae or capped brood present, but no eggs seen.
brood.patchy: Brood present in a spotty or irregular pattern.
brood.drone_brood_only: Only drone brood, including drone brood in worker cells.

stores.plentiful: More stores than the colony needs; room to harvest.
stores.adequate: Enough stores for the colony's current needs.
stores.low: Stores are short; feeding may be needed.

temperament.calm: Bees stay on the frames; little or no reaction.
temperament.nervous: Bees run on the frames or take to the air, no stinging.
temperament.defensive: Bees fly at the beekeeper; some stings.
temperament.aggressive: Sustained attack; many stings; bees follow.
